A short delivery? Quote your order number: Orders spoken in our app are never created in Altametrics, so its receiving and credit tracking will not have them. If the truck comes up short, raise it with your distributor and quote the number on your confirmation. If you track credits in Altametrics, enter that credit there by hand.

Begin where your plan has no ordering: If you run Altametrics for labor and cash only, begin with whichever supplier still takes your order over the phone; no Altametrics alternative is needed for that. If a distributor already gets your orders through Zip Ordering or Altametrics, use one place only for that distributor, so the same cases never come twice.
Brand rules come first: If your brand requires Altametrics for ordering, or approved distributors only, follow that. Check with head office before you move any supplier's ordering to our app.

@graph.name: Would I need an Altametrics alternative to start speaking my orders?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Where one of your distributors has our app, you can order from them by voice on your phone, and use Altametrics for the rest, its ordering included if your plan has it. This is about supplies you buy, not orders from your guests.

@graph.name: Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than Altametrics?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not at what Altametrics does. We run no schedules, payroll, counts, forecasts or food cost reports. You read your order into our app for a distributor that has it, and go over every item before it is sent. If your plan leaves out ordering and phoning the rep is why you looked for an Altametrics alternative, that call is what our app replaces.

@graph.name: Do VoiceOrder Solutions and Altametrics connect?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. These are two products from two companies, each with its own help desk, and no data moves from one to the other. Orders you speak in our app reach only your distributor, and Altametrics does not see them.

@graph.name: My Altametrics plan has no ordering. Does this add it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not inside Altametrics. Our app carries orders to the distributors who use it, and that is all: it does not count stock, suggest amounts or receive deliveries. Altametrics lists those, with ordering, in its Advanced plan, and it also offers Zip Ordering, a separate app. If you want those inside Altametrics, ask Altametrics about them.

@graph.name: I run a franchise location. Can I order this way?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, with a distributor using our app, as long as your brand lets you order from that distributor yourself. Where the brand insists on Altametrics or approved suppliers only, do it their way. Suppliers without our app get your orders just as they do now.

@graph.name: What if I say one thing and the screen shows another?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before sending, fix it on the review screen: choose the correct item, change the number, or remove the line. That review is the safeguard, and a hurried glance can still let a mistake slip by. Orders made by phone or left on voicemail get no order number from us; only orders sent in the app do.

@graph.name: How do I get set up, and what does it cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The distributor opens an account for you and loads your guide, and most kitchens get an order in on that same day. Until that distributor has it, go on ordering from them as you do today, and reach out to us: we will connect you with the right person. Cost is something to ask that distributor, since our app comes to you from them; we publish no price. Altametrics shows prices for its entry plans and quotes the larger ones.

@graph.name: Where do the Altametrics details on this page come from?

acceptedAnswer.text: From altametrics.com and zipordering.com as we read them on 9 November 2026: the Altametrics homepage, pricing, inventory, back office and forecasting pages, and the Zip Ordering homepage. If any of it is out of date, write to us and we will correct it.
